summary_en: Where supply meets demand in public — consumer portals, listing networks and transactional marketplaces.
summary_fr: Là où l'offre rencontre la demande en public — portails grand public, réseaux d'annonces et places de marché transactionnelles.

tools.name: Apartments.com
tools.positioning: The dominant US rental marketplace, bundled with free tooling that pulls small landlords onto the platform.
tools.description: CoStar's rental network — Apartments.com and its sister sites — lists apartments and single-family rentals nationally. Alongside paid advertising for professional managers, it offers small landlords free listing, online applications, tenant screening, lease signing and rent collection.
tools.real_estate_use: A professional manager buys placement and lead volume for a lease-up. An individual landlord uses the free side as their entire operating system: list the unit, receive applications with credit and background checks, sign a state-specific lease and collect rent by ACH. That free tier is why so many small portfolios never buy dedicated property management software.
features: National rental listing network with paid placement tiers
Online rental applications with tenant screening
State-specific lease templates and e-signature
Online rent collection and payment tracking
Renter profiles and application reuse
Rental market rent comparables for pricing

use_cases.job: Fill vacancies in a lease-up with paid placement and measured lead volume
List, screen, lease and collect rent on a handful of units at no software cost

tools.name: Bien'ici
tools.positioning: The portal founded by the French networks themselves, built around a 3D map search rather than a list of results.
tools.description: Bien'ici is a French property portal created by a consortium of real estate networks and professional groups. Its distinguishing feature is a 3D cartographic search showing a property in its actual urban context, with commute-time filtering and neighbourhood information.
tools.real_estate_use: It exists because French professionals wanted a portal they partly control, as a counterweight to portal pricing power. For an agency, the practical calculation is the same as anywhere — leads against subscription cost — with the added argument that the map-based search attracts buyers doing serious location research rather than casual browsing.
features: 3D map-based property search in urban context
Commute time and point-of-interest filtering
Professional sale and rental listings
Neighbourhood and environment information
New-build programme sections
Lead delivery to agency software

use_cases.job: Advertise on a portal partly governed by the professional networks themselves
Search by commute time and urban context rather than by postcode

tools.name: Crexi
tools.positioning: A CRE marketplace that also runs the deal — listing, bidding, due diligence room and comps in one place.
tools.description: Crexi combines a commercial listing marketplace with transaction tooling: offer management, an auction platform, a virtual deal room, and Crexi Intelligence for sales comparables, ownership records and lease data. It positions itself as the challenger to the incumbent CoStar and LoopNet pairing.
tools.real_estate_use: A broker lists an asset, receives structured offers or runs a timed auction, and shares due-diligence documents through a permissioned data room instead of a shared drive link. Buyers use Crexi Intelligence to check what comparable assets traded for and who owns the building next door before committing to underwriting.
features: Commercial listing marketplace across asset classes
Structured offer submission and auction platform
Permissioned virtual due-diligence rooms
Crexi Intelligence comparables, ownership and lease data
Broker CRM and buyer activity analytics
Marketing tools including flyers and email campaigns

use_cases.job: Run a competitive bid process on an asset with a controlled document room
Check sale comparables and ownership before underwriting an acquisition

tools.name: Homes.com
tools.positioning: The portal built on the "your listing, your lead" promise — the listing agent is the one shown on their own listing.
tools.description: Relaunched by CoStar Group with heavy consumer advertising, Homes.com differentiates from the incumbent portals by not selling a competing agent's advertising slot on top of a listing. It is backed by CoStar's data infrastructure and adds neighbourhood-level editorial content.
tools.real_estate_use: The pitch to listing agents is defensive: winning a listing is easier when the seller knows their own agent will appear on the portal page rather than three buyers' agents who paid for the ZIP code. Membership products give agents branded profiles and listing boosts, and brokerages use it as a counterweight to portal lead pricing.
features: Listing pages that display the listing agent rather than paid competitors
Agent membership profiles and branded listing presentation
Neighbourhood and school editorial content
National consumer advertising driving portal traffic
Rental listing network
CoStar-sourced property and market data

use_cases.job: Win a listing appointment by promising the seller exclusive agent visibility
Reduce dependency on portals that resell leads on the brokerage's own inventory

tools.name: Leboncoin Immobilier
tools.positioning: The generalist classified site that became France's highest-traffic property channel — private sellers and agencies side by side.
tools.description: Leboncoin's real estate section carries both private-seller and professional listings for sale and rental across France, sold to professionals through listing packs and visibility options, and benefiting from the traffic of one of the country's largest websites.
tools.real_estate_use: Its dual nature defines its role. Agencies advertise here for volume at a lower cost per listing than the professional portals. At the same time it is the main source for the pige — the private-seller listings that agencies canvass for mandates. The same platform is therefore both a marketing channel and a prospecting ground.
features: Private and professional sale and rental listings
Professional listing packs and visibility options
National generalist audience
Lead routing to professional accounts
New-build and programme listings
Rental application handling for some listing types

use_cases.job: Reach the largest French property audience at a lower cost per listing
Identify private sellers to canvass for a mandate

tools.name: LoopNet
tools.positioning: The public shop window for US commercial property — where a CRE listing goes to be found by someone outside your rolodex.
tools.description: LoopNet is CoStar's public-facing commercial marketplace, covering office, retail, industrial, multifamily and land for sale and for lease. Paid listing tiers determine search placement and exposure; the underlying property records come from CoStar's research operation.
tools.real_estate_use: A broker marketing a warehouse or a strip centre buys a listing tier to reach principals and out-of-market buyers that a local network would miss. Investors use it as a screening tool for asking prices and available inventory before paying for CoStar-grade data. It is a marketing channel, not an underwriting source.
features: Commercial for-sale and for-lease listings across all asset classes
Tiered paid placement determining search visibility
Property and demographic detail from CoStar research
Lead capture and inquiry routing to the listing broker
Portfolio and auction marketing options
Broker and firm profile pages

use_cases.job: Expose a commercial listing beyond the local broker network to national buyers
Screen available inventory and asking prices in a target market

tools.name: PAP (De Particulier à Particulier)
tools.positioning: The private-to-private marketplace — no agencies, by design, since long before the internet.
tools.description: PAP publishes only listings from private individuals, excluding real estate professionals as a matter of editorial policy. It provides sellers and landlords with listing tools, document templates and guidance for handling a transaction or a tenancy without an agency.
tools.real_estate_use: Two opposite uses. For an owner it is the reference channel for selling or letting without paying agency fees, with the legal templates that decision requires. For an agency it is a pure pige source: every listing on PAP is by definition an owner who has chosen not to use a professional, which makes it the hardest and most valuable canvassing ground in France.
features: Private-seller and private-landlord listings only
Listing publication tools for individuals
Lease, notice and transaction document templates
Guidance content on selling and letting without an agency
Rental application handling between individuals
Regional editions and search

use_cases.job: Sell or let a property without agency fees, with the paperwork provided
Canvass owners who have explicitly chosen to go without an agency

tools.name: Realtor.com
tools.positioning: The portal operated under licence from the National Association of REALTORS, fed directly by MLS data.
tools.description: Realtor.com is a consumer portal whose distinguishing claim is data freshness: listings come from MLS feeds under an NAR operating agreement rather than from scraped or syndicated sources. Its professional side sells Connections Plus and Market Reach advertising, and it owns rental products including Avail.
tools.real_estate_use: Agents buy exclusive or shared buyer leads by ZIP code and use the platform's listing presence as a seller-pitch argument. Because the feed comes from the MLS, status changes propagate faster than on aggregators, which matters when a client is comparing what is actually still available.
features: MLS-sourced for-sale and for-rent listings
Connections Plus buyer lead products by ZIP code
Market Reach display advertising to a farm area
RealEstimate valuation range from multiple models
Agent profiles and review collection
Rental products including Avail for small landlords

use_cases.job: Acquire buyer leads in a defined ZIP code with MLS-accurate inventory behind them
Show a seller the reach their listing gets across the portal network

tools.name: SeLoger
tools.positioning: The historic French professional portal — where agencies pay to be seen, and where most French property searches still begin.
tools.description: SeLoger is a French property portal for sale and rental listings, historically restricted to professionals and now part of Aviv Group alongside Logic-Immo and MeilleursAgents. It sells agencies listing packs, visibility options and lead products, with new-build programme sections for developers.
tools.real_estate_use: For a French agency the SeLoger subscription is usually the largest single marketing line, and its renewal is an annual argument: the agency compares the leads it produced against Leboncoin's cheaper volume and its own website. Because the portal is professional-only, the listings carry mandate information, which is why buyers use it differently from the classified sites.
features: Professional sale and rental listings across France
Agency listing packs and visibility boosting options
Lead delivery to agency software and CRMs
New-build programme sections for developers
Agency profile pages and branding
Audience and performance reporting per listing

use_cases.job: Buy portal visibility for a mandate portfolio and measure the leads it returns
Market a new-build programme to French buyers on a dedicated section

tools.name: Zelok
tools.positioning: Dossier locataire en ligne partagé entre agences, doublé d'une assurance loyers impayés souscrite via le professionnel qui gère le bien.
tools.description: Zelok is a French rental platform with two connected halves. Tenants build one online application file, reusable across agencies, and search through an engine that scans listings published by professionals — the vendor cites more than 380,000 listings drawn from over 50 platforms and filtered against the applicant's criteria. Real estate professionals and the landlords they act for get the unpaid-rent side: a Garantie Totale insurance product that pays the rent every month on a fixed date, with compensation from the first euro within 24 hours, and cover for property damage and legal protection. The vendor states more than 37,000 professional partners and one tenant file created every twenty seconds.
tools.real_estate_use: A letting agent handling a portfolio for private landlords has two recurring problems: incomplete applications and owners who panic at the first missed payment. Zelok solves them in the same place — candidates arrive with a file already assembled and shared, and the agent subscribes the lease to the unpaid-rent guarantee so the owner receives the rent on a fixed date regardless of what the tenant does. For the applicant, the file is built once in a few minutes and reused with every agency contacted, and the search engine surfaces matching listings rather than requiring the applicant to monitor fifty portals. The agent also uses the platform as a way to win management mandates from owners who want the guarantee.
features: Dossier locataire en ligne réutilisable, partagé entre plusieurs agences
Moteur de recherche agrégeant les annonces de professionnels sur plus de 50 plateformes
Assurance loyers impayés Garantie Totale souscrite via un professionnel
Indemnisation dès le premier euro, sous 24 heures
Couverture des dégradations immobilières et protection juridique
Espace professionnel de suivi des dossiers candidats et des garanties

use_cases.job: Recevoir des candidatures déjà constituées et souscrire la garantie loyers impayés du bail dans le même outil
Constituer un dossier une seule fois et le présenter à toutes les agences contactées
Percevoir le loyer à date fixe malgré un impayé, via le professionnel qui gère le bien

tools.name: Zillow
tools.positioning: The consumer entry point to US residential real estate, and therefore the largest paid lead channel for agents.
tools.description: Zillow is a consumer property portal carrying for-sale, for-rent and off-market inventory, the Zestimate automated valuation, and a set of professional products — Premier Agent advertising, Zillow Showcase listing enhancement, rental listing syndication and a mortgage marketplace.
tools.real_estate_use: For an agent, Zillow is rarely a listing tool and almost always an acquisition channel: buyer leads are sold by ZIP code share of voice through Premier Agent, and a seller conversation frequently starts from a Zestimate the owner has already seen. For a landlord, the rentals network is a primary source of applicants. Its data is also the reference point clients bring to a pricing meeting.
features: Consumer for-sale, for-rent and off-market property search
Zestimate automated valuation on most US homes
Premier Agent advertising sold by ZIP code
Zillow Showcase enhanced listing presentation
Rental listing syndication and application handling
Agent finder and review profiles

use_cases.job: Buy buyer-side leads in a target ZIP code and measure cost per closing
Advertise a rental unit and collect applications from a national audience

tools.name: Zumper
tools.positioning: A rental marketplace built around applying from the phone, with instant-book style flows.
tools.description: Zumper is a rental listing marketplace covering apartments, houses and rooms, with in-platform applications, screening and rent payment. Its consumer positioning is speed: find, apply and be approved without a physical appointment.
tools.real_estate_use: Landlords and managers list here to reach renters who search on mobile and expect to apply immediately. For smaller landlords the platform doubles as the application and screening workflow, and its published national rent index is a common reference point in pricing discussions.
features: Rental marketplace for apartments, houses and rooms
In-platform applications and screening
Instant-apply flows and verified listings
Rent payment collection
National rent report and market index
Landlord dashboard for listing performance

use_cases.job: List a unit and take applications from mobile-first renters
Reach renters outside the incumbent portal networks
